text.model: Enhanced fast word+char TF-IDF LinearSVC trained on SDCNL UMAP-GMM label-corrected labels
text.evaluation_basis: SDCNL-style label-corrected test labels (separate from original web-label baseline)

decision.status: prototype research decision layer; not clinically validated and not jointly calibrated on paired text-speech suicide labels
decision.rationale: Text receives higher weight because SDCNL directly models suicide/depression language. The primary text model is trained on SDCNL-style confidence-corrected labels. EATD models SDS-derived depression/distress. No paired ground truth exists to learn multimodal fusion weights.

TEXT ONLY.disclaimer: Research screening prototype only. The enhanced text branch is trained using SDCNL-style UMAP-GMM confidence-based label correction (tau=0.90). Its 85.75% result is a label-corrected evaluation and is reported separately from the original-web-label baseline. The speech branch uses EATD SDS-derived depression/distress audio rather than direct suicide labels. The modalities are not participant-matched, so the combined score is not a clinically validated suicide-risk probability or diagnosis.

speech.model: single-audio acoustic Logistic Regression selected with participant-grouped CV
